research_contract.question: Does the already-opened SWE-bench Verified eleven-Agent development panel contain budget-ten selection headroom and candidate-independent evidence that repository-local history predicts future pass rate better than an unseen-target constant estimator?
research_contract.reason_for_source: This is the only ready normalized source that changes both Task source and Agent panel after the Multi-SWE pilot without a paid call or a sealed-outcome open. It is a bounded source-transfer check, not an atlas.
research_contract.runtime_boundary: Runtime remains one repository, one Task Pool, and one Selection. The seven repositories are independent offline evidence units and are never combined into a runtime Task Pool.
research_contract.primary_metric: future pass-rate mean absolute error over the fixed eleven-Agent panel
research_contract.primary_estimand: Agent mean inside Origin, Origin mean inside repository, then equal-weight repository mean
research_contract.primary_comparison: full eligible repository-local history minus always-zero MAE
research_contract.claim_boundary: The public outcomes and projected created_at ordering support an exploratory source-time counterfactual only. They cannot establish native Result availability, production workload relevance, a useful deployment margin, or a Selector.
non_solutions: opening any of the six project-sealed holdout Agents
running the three-Agent or SymPy panels after this row merely to search for a favorable source
tuning or nominating a Selector from this candidate-free audit
choosing a different horizon, Origin construction, aggregation, or null after reading the result
treating a cached-target climatology as admissible for an unseen-target Selector
making a paid call or developing a Generator

source.normalization: resolved is pass; every other Task in the exact 500-Task denominator is fail

agent_panel.definition: the three agent_panel entries in the bound public plan plus the eight development_allocation entries in the bound extension plan
agent_panel.sealed_holdout_policy: The holdout_allocation entries and their result blobs remain unopened and are not inputs to this audit.
agent_panel.result_identity: Every opened result file must match the Git blob SHA frozen in its source manifest before normalization.

frame.origin_alignment: end-aligned complete non-overlapping future blocks using build_repository_origins

unseen_target_estimator_lane.always_zero: predict pass rate zero for every Agent and Origin
unseen_target_estimator_lane.always_one: predict pass rate one for every Agent and Origin
unseen_target_estimator_lane.full_history: use each target Agent's pass rate over every eligible historical Task; this is the primary no-Selection baseline
unseen_target_estimator_lane.equal_budget_random: independently sample ten history Tasks uniformly without replacement at every Origin for 20000 draws
unseen_target_estimator_lane.discrete_hindsight: solve the exact budget-ten response-pattern subset against opened future outcomes at every Origin

cached_target_diagnostic_lane.expanding_median_climatology: for each repository and Agent, predict the median of all earlier complete future-block pass rates; at the first Origin, fall back to that Origin's full-history pass rate
cached_target_diagnostic_lane.claim_limit: This lane requires target-Agent outcomes before the cutoff. It is reported separately and is not a gate for unseen-target prediction.

random_calibration.reported_value: equal-repository mean random-subset MAE and its distribution relative to full history

hindsight.optimality: require a successful exact integer solution at every Origin
hindsight.interpretation: This is a dense capacity diagnostic after future outcomes open, not an executable Selector.

uncertainty.bootstrap_generator: Python random.Random(seed), sample seven repository rows with replacement using randrange
uncertainty.interval: percentile 95 percent interval for equal-repository full-minus-zero
uncertainty.quantile_rule: linear interpolation at index probability times count minus one

temporal_null.statistic: equal-repository mean full-history MAE minus always-zero MAE; lower is more favorable to history persistence
temporal_null.construction: For every draw and repository, choose one independent circular offset uniformly from zero through repository_task_count minus one and shift the complete ordered eleven-dimensional Task response rows together. Preserve Task times, Origin membership, repository prevalence, joint Agent response vectors, and response-sequence adjacency up to the circular boundary.
temporal_null.generator: Initialize Python random.Random(seed); for each draw and sorted repository call randrange(repository_task_count) once.
temporal_null.p_value: (1 + number of null statistics at most observed) / (draws + 1)
temporal_null.claim: A small value detects alignment of aggregate history persistence with the observed Task chronology. Failure to detect does not prove that every pre-Origin Task feature is useless.

decision_rules.capacity_present: exact budget-ten hindsight MAE is below full-history MAE
decision_rules.history_persistence_detected: capacity is present, full-minus-zero is negative, the repository-bootstrap upper endpoint is negative, every leave-one-repository-out full-minus-zero value is negative, and the temporal-null one-sided probability is at most 0.05
decision_rules.pass_route: Freeze this opened panel as an exploratory counterfactual development boundary and begin Stage C theory-driven algorithm research without touching the six sealed Agents.
decision_rules.fail_or_unresolved_route: Stop the suitability-atlas expansion. Do not run the three-Agent or SymPy row; the next data action is either SWE-bench Full normalization or acquisition of a workload-matched source.

authority.implementation_scope: one direct SWE-bench Verified experiment module reusing existing loaders and statistical helpers, focused tests, ignored raw results, a compact self-digested summary, and claim-boundary documentation
